prompt:
Deep Superagent bounded engineering task. Public repository source only. No customer data, no mail bodies, no credentials, no amounts, no wallet or signer material in any output.

OWNER AUTHORIZATION (2026-11-17, this session): the relay GPT seat IS authorized to act as the runtime adjudication seat for all matters EXCEPT funds, disbursement/loan, refund money movement, signing, wallet/Safe operations and credential access. Those five categories stay outside every model seat and must escalate as needs_owner_decision. Scope expansion beyond this sentence is not granted.

CURRENT BLOCKER (verified on main): config/seat-roles-20261116.json already defines relay_gpt as kind=bounded_adjudicator with four dispositions, and config/deep-superagent.json still reports decision_authority=false with decision_seat resolving to a manual owner path. Runtime therefore cannot adjudicate: relay output is treated as execution receipt only, and no decision stage exists in the queue.

DELIVER in one PR against current main, then deploy:
1. Add an owner authorization record OWNER-AUTH-20261117-RELAY-ADJ with authorized_at 2026-11-17, scope = all matters except funds/disbursement/loan/refund money movement/signing/wallet or Safe/credential access, excluded = those five categories, revocable = true, and set relay_gpt adjudication_enabled = true with decision_authority = true bounded to that scope. Keep financial_execution = false, signed = false, transaction_adapter_ready = false everywhere.
2. Implement a discrete decision stage (separate from the execution receipt path) that: sends a bounded batch to the relay, validates strict JSON per disposition (approve_in_scope, conditional_approve, return_for_revision, needs_decision) with the required fields already listed in seat-roles, binds task_id plus input_sha256, records actual provider/model metadata returned by the proxy, marks relay_attested = false when upstream attestation is unavailable, and never upgrades a relay decision into a production or funds authorization.
3. Hard fail-closed: missing acceptance gate, missing proxy token, host or model not allowlisted, missing batch header, non-JSON or malformed output, unknown task_id or hash mismatch, duplicate decision on the same task_id, transport timeout or unknown delivery => emit no decision and mark the item undecided. No retry of an unknown outcome.
4. Fund-family items (funds, disbursement, loan, refund money movement, signing, wallet/Safe, credential access) must be short-circuited to needs_owner_decision BEFORE any relay call, and the code must prove it with a test.
5. Tests: four dispositions, malformed JSON, wrong task_id, hash mismatch, duplicate decision, timeout with no retry, out-of-scope escalation, fund-family short circuit, and native DeepSeek independent review of a relay decision. Existing suites must stay green.
6. Deploy: merge only after required CI is green; run the repo deployment workflow that owns the runtime; capture run id, job, commit SHA, deployed version readback and a smoke call evidence path. If online smoke cannot be obtained, record DEPLOYED_BUT_NOT_SMOKE_VERIFIED explicitly, do not claim end-to-end acceptance.
7. Distribution: update the seat documentation and the ruling-tracking entry so every seat sees the new adjudication route, then write a receipt with task_id, commit, run id, test output path, evidence paths and explicit writes_performed / merges_performed / deploys_performed counts.

Do not touch real money, signing, wallet or Safe, credentials, customer data, or any payment configuration. Do not claim the adjudicator is operational before the smoke evidence exists.

FORMAT
- Planner deepseek: return ONLY JSON {"summary":"<=100 chars","tasks":[{"seat":"claude","task":"<=1800 chars"}],"needs_gpt_decision":false,"reason":null}. Exactly one worker task. No prose outside the JSON.
- Worker claude: return a bounded implementation package, no prose outside it: (a) exact files to change with unified diff hunks, (b) the decision-stage JSON schema, (c) the fund-family short-circuit predicate, (d) the test list with assertions, (e) deploy steps with PASS criteria and rollback, (f) the receipt fields. One screen per section, no summary, no tasks, no plan echo, no provider/model self-declaration beyond metadata fields the proxy actually returns.
